description: Preview how the SDK's canonical writer would change an @ExerisDomain source file for one mutation, applied in memory. Returns `{ result, sourcePath, diff }`: a unified diff and the SDK outcome in `result.outcome` — SUCCESS, CONFLICT (the source drifted from the baseline; the result carries baseline, current and intended values), VALIDATION_ERROR, or NO_BASELINE. Nothing is written: apply the diff with your own file tools. For a stale-free preview, pass the entity's last-emitted metadata as `baselineJson` and the `sourceDigest` from `lsp-describe_domain` as `concurrencyToken`.

baselineJson.description: The entity's last-emitted `target/classes/exeris-metadata/<entity>.json` (see `build-get_domain_metadata`), as a string. The base of the three-way drift check.

concurrencyToken.description: The `sourceDigest` returned by `lsp-describe_domain` for this domain.

op.description: One SDK MutationOp, discriminated by `op`: addField, removeField, renameField, changeFieldType, addRelationship, removeRelationship, changeRelationshipCardinality, addAction, removeAction. Every op carries a `path`, e.g. {"op":"renameField","path":"/entities/Order/fields/total","newName":"amount"}.

qualifiedName.description: Fully-qualified Java class name of the target domain.

name: lsp-preview_mutation
